name: Achilleus Ralli
bio: Achilleus Ralli is a Greek-Thai martial artist, former national judo champion, coach, sports organizer, and actor based in Thailand.

credits.title: 23 Seconds
credits.overview: A former Silat champion enters amateur MMA to honor his brother lost in a Phuket Tsunami, while underground Muay Thai fighter Somchai is chosen to represent Thailand at the world championship in Jakarta. Two warriors, who will prevail?
